messages.subject: Big bug with Shiny R +  google charts binder!
parts:
I have installed dplyr and google charts binder as recommended by the googlecharts binder docs...
once done, i have added appropriate library (googleCharts) to UI and library (dplyr) to server.
Once done the rstudio goes crazy
It doesnt want to interpret any parameters / additional widgets added to a single column, and it only allows for one item  / widget in each column.
Any fixes ?
it probably has to do something with encoding ?
I use UTF - 8

Even if I remove the library (googleCharts) and library (dplyr) from UI and SERVER files it doesnt fix it. The code won't run with any more then one widget / parameter in per column

Any  fixes ?
